person: a best friend who moved away
shape: a small everyday annoyance someone causes now, seen from the day it stops

slides.text: the day they stopped borrowing [[my favorite pen]], i finally wrote without hunting, and the page felt mine again

caption:
i still hear their laugh when the kettle whistles.
the empty chair at the table feels less heavy now.
sometimes i find their old mixtape and smile.
send this to the friend who always hides your pens.

#friendshipquotes #bestfriendquotes #childhoodfriends #longdistancefriendship
alt: a point_right green donkey beside the line about a friend stopping borrowing the narrator's favorite pen, allowing them to write freely
